reviews.comment:
Realice el service completo de cambio de aceite y escaneo general. Debo destacar todo el servicio desde la atención del cliente con el contacto por whatsapp. La recepción y profesionalismo de quienes me atendieron. Soy una persona con poco conocimiento de automóviles, por lo cual consulté, se me respondió con paciencia y mucho conocimiento. Hasta me explicaron el resultado del escaneo. Destaco la labor de ambos profesionales que incluso hice uja consulta por fuera de su labor y me guiaron como proceder. Recomiendo ampliamente que asistan al boxes del ACA de Villa Carlos Paz. Felicitaciones muchachos por su excelente trabajo, si evaluáramos el punta a punta del proceso no se detectarían quiebres, en gestión de calidad excelente. En cuanto al personal de playa que decir, felicito a todos y cada uno. Su calidad de atención, la calidez, dispuestos a resolver siempre. Me ayudarob y asistieron con un problema de luces cuando me detuve a cargar nafta y no me aceptaron ni un peso, amables es poco. Considero desde mi visión de cliente y de mi experiencia como analista de calidad que merecen ser mas que felicitados todos. Saludos.

(Translated by Google)
I had a complete oil change and general scan done. I must highlight the entire service, from the initial customer contact via WhatsApp to the warm welcome and professionalism of the staff. I'm not very knowledgeable about cars, so when I asked questions, they answered patiently and with great expertise. They even explained the scan results to me. I want to emphasize the work of both professionals; I even asked a question outside of their usual duties, and they guided me on how to proceed. I highly recommend visiting the ACA service center in Villa Carlos Paz. Congratulations, guys, on your excellent work! If we were to evaluate the entire process, we wouldn't find a single flaw; your quality management is outstanding. As for the service bay staff, what can I say? I congratulate each and every one of them. Their quality of service, their warmth, and their willingness to help were outstanding. They even helped me with a problem with the lights when I stopped to refuel, and they wouldn't accept a single peso from me—kindness is an understatement. From my perspective as a customer and my experience as a quality analyst, I believe they all deserve more than just praise. Greetings.
